verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace that stores user data on pods, volumes and backups, so a data region/residency choice is a fair question for it. The evidence never documents choosing a storage region or residency, for pods, volumes or backups. The Confidential Computing node filter and encryption at rest are related privacy controls, not location choice, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
